stats.method: Native EPSG:26910 centrelines buffered by recorded SURFACE_WIDTH/2, dissolved at intersections, draped on available terrain. Ground surfaces exclude bridge-labelled records.
stats.limits: City centre lines approximate the dedicated right-of-way centre, not necessarily the physical road centre. Segment widths do not locate individual curbs, parking bays, medians or sidewalk edges. Missing widths remain centre lines. This is an approximate surface model.
